pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

2. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only a joining word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

3. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. No full stops

4. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.

5. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.

6. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.

7. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.

8. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

9. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

10. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. happiness

11. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. going
   C. goes
   D. goed

12. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Where is the library?

2. D — A person, place, thing, or idea

3. B — One main idea with supporting sentences

4. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

5. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.

6. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

7. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

8. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

9. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

10. C — run

11. A — went

12. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Attentive Listening; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Word Reading; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Connected text and fluency; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language Activities at home; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
